budget_items.topic: Capital planning, pump and generator work
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital planning worksheet estimated annual capital work of about $95K-100K, mostly pump and generator upgrades.
budget_items.quote: they are looking at about $95k-100k each year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Estimate of about $40K each for replacing pumps at Dana Street, Leominster Rd and Mass 1, with grant money mentioned as available.
budget_items.quote: robert estimated the pumps for dana street, leominster rd and mass 1 could be $40k each.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed Capital maintenance line item for pump replacement at $95K.
budget_items.quote: if a pump needs to be replaced, it comes from the capital maintenance line item, which she is proposing at $95k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Infrastructure Maintenance line of $47,600 for replacing parts.
budget_items.quote: infrastructure maintenance for $47,600 would be for replacing parts.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Worksheet modelled potential rate increases from the current rate of $13.66 and their effect on transfers from Retained Earnings.
budget_items.quote: potential rate increases from the current rate of $13.66 and how it would affect transfers from retained earnings.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Leominster rate came down from a projected figure; current rate stated with scheduled increases for FY25 and FY26, then penny-for-penny increases after FY26.
budget_items.quote: she noted that the rate did come down from the projected $6.46. currently the rate is $5.32 and will go up to $6.18 for fy25 and $6.37 for fy26.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Prior consultant was given $100K to work on the Maintenance Plan but did not spend all of it.
budget_items.quote: they gave him $100k to work on the maintenance plan, but he did not spend it all.
